CREATE PROC [DW].[HIST_SP_DW_FACTAVERAGEDAILYBALANCEMTD2] @Businessdate [VARCHAR](10) AS
BEGIN

WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'Average Current Balance'
    AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' --AND @Businessdate BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODSTARTDATE,112) AND ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112),'20991231')
)
,CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
    SELECT BCB.CustomerAccountId, COUNT(1) CNT FROM CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCB
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountID 
    and DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    GROUP BY BCB.CustomerAccountId

)
,Balance AS (
SELECT 
CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCPB.PeriodStartDate,112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId

--,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate
--    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount END  AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
--,CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate )/ ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  
--    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount / ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1)  
--    END AS AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated


,BCPB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm

,BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode
,BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId
,BCPB.BalanceAmount
,ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1) CNT

FROM 
CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCPB
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CAFP.ProductId = FPA.FinancialProductId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount  BCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDBK ON BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.CustomerAccountId 
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
 AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
 --AND @Businessdate NOT IN (SELECT BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD)
)
,GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK,
	BankSK,
	AccountSK,
    AccountId,
	SourceSystemCode, 
    MIN(BusinessDateSK) as min_date, 
    CONVERT(DATE, '2023-06-01') max_date 
  FROM 
    Balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
    GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	b.BranchSK,
    b.BankSK,
    b.AccountSK,
    b.AccountID,
	b.SourceSystemCode,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,FullDate,112) AS FullDate2,
    a.FullDate, 
    b.min_date, 
    b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
  WHERE 
    (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,Distinct_Balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, BalanceAmount, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm ,IsoCurrencyCode ,FinancialInstitutionId ,CNT
FROM Balance b
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
, join_balance as (
select 
 ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate) AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BalanceAmount
,CNT
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [BalanceAmount] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

)

, rowgrp as (
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup from join_balance
)
,final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode is not null then BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode else first_value(BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end IsoCurrencyCode
,case when BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId is not null then BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId else first_value(BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end FinancialInstitutionId
,case when [BalanceAmount] is not null then BalanceAmount else first_value(BalanceAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end BalanceAmount
,case when [CNT] is not null then CNT else first_value(CNT) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CNT
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm                           
from rowgrp BCPB) 


INSERT INTO DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD
(
     BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)
select 
CONVERT(VARCHAR,convert(date,BusinessDateSK),112) BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate
    ELSE BalanceAmount END AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate )/ CNT
    ELSE BalanceAmount / CNT  
    END AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm           
from  final_balance   BCPB
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON  BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode  = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCPB.BusinessDateSK) = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp

END
